citation.title: Effects of a branched-chain amino acid sports drink on multiple sprint exercise performance, blood glucose and cognitive function (placebo arm read)

reported.what: placebo-arm heart rate after each of five 1 km sprints, mean ± SD (n=11)
placebo-arm capillary blood lactate before and 2 min after the five-sprint protocol, mean ± SD
placebo-arm mean power output of each 1 km sprint, mean ± SD (W)

detail: Subjects were fed, not fasted (only 2 h without food or drink, no meal or its content printed), and the placebo (2.75 g of non-medicinal ingredients, composition only in Figure 2) is not shown to be carbohydrate-free, so no pre-exercise lactate can be entered as a fasting or meal-defined value; the sprints are 1 km efforts with no printed duration, so the minutes of the bout, of the post-sprint heart rates and of the post-trial lactate cannot be placed, and there is no printed intensity other than mean watts over an unknown span.
